required_operator_actions: create a dedicated Cloudflare Access application + audience for this runtime, distinct from the Pages Command Center's audience
run a private reverse-proxy (e.g. a cloudflared tunnel) from that Access application to 127.0.0.1:8788 on the VPS — no raw public Node port
place runtime secrets in /etc/jarvis/remote-operator.env on the VPS (mode 600), never committed
install deploy/jarvis-remote-operator.service.example as a systemd unit and enable it
confirm /api/status returns 401 with no Access session and 200 with one, through the Access-fronted URL
purpose: expose the existing, accepted V2 Command Center + Program Controller privately and continuously from the operator's own VPS, without weakening local-operator-server-v1.js's local-only auth contract
